crisis.button.draft: Nazali na mposa ya lisalisi sikawa

phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Mosala ya mwa ntango moke na mboka wana, talá na mokonzi na yo mpo na koyeba soki azali na ndingisa ya kobima na bolɔkɔ.

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Mikano ya kobomba mbongo mpe plan ya komibongisa mpo na ndako. Groundwork epesaka ndako te mpe esalaka na boyokani te na bato oyo bapesaka yango. Mpo na lisalisi ya mboka, bengá 211.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.

phase3.tokensHelp.draft: Ba-token ezalaka na motuya ya mbongo te.

reentry.call211.draft: Libyangi 211 mpo na biloko ya mboka

reentry.crisisStep.en: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.crisisStep.draft: Kobomba mitángo oyo sikawa. Okoki mpe kobɛta Esengeli lisalisi sikawa na likoló ya écran nyonso.

reentry.steps.step11.draft: Kobomba 988 mpe 911 na telefone na yo

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Tyá dati nyonso ya tribinale na kalandriye

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution
reentry.steps.step17.draft: Talelá bafaktire na yo, bafaktire na yo mpe mbongo oyo ozongisaki

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
reentry.steps.step19.draft: Komá nkombo na lisungi ya monganga, mpe soki ozali na mposa na yango, salelá yango mbala moko

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Luká esika ya malamu ya kolala (bengá 211 to na bisika mosusu)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Luká bilei mpo na pɔsɔ oyo (bengá 211 to esika batɛkaka bilei)

safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: Na boumeli ya ngonga 24 ya liboso nsima ya kozonga na mboka na yo, salá makambo na kimya.

safety.vaultHelp.en: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.vaultHelp.draft: Mikanda na yo ekomami na cryptographie, ezali na programɛ ya kofuta mbongo; ntalo eyebani naino te.

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.resourcesNote.draft: Lisungi ya mibeko, lisalisi ya monganga mpe kokatisa mboka.

wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: Ozali yo moko te. Butoni ya mpasi oyo ezali na likoló ezali ntango nyonso awa  ⁇  bengá to tinda 988, to 911 na ntango ya likama.

work.paroleNote.en: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.
work.paroleNote.draft: Liboso ya kosɛnga ndingisa, sololá na mokonzi ya bapolisi mpo na koyeba soki ozali na bolɔkɔ to te.
